verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a payments platform with SDKs, dashboards and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection or any opt-out control. The cited items cover payments, catalog, inventory, webhooks, sandbox, MCP and pricing instead.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
